change_summary: Translate future-continuity retention into one weak Work Model reconciliation, then require direct organization missions to choose corpus coverage from independent future-work duties before their first semantic plan.

canonical_skill.note: The canonical Skill keeps the Host handoff weak while making future-continuity retention proceed from verified upload into one Work Model reconciliation unless the user explicitly asks for raw archival only.

server_contract.note: Contract 2026-09-15.2 aligns the future-continuity route across adapters; direct Mission planning now proves one bounded future job before skipping the existing low-cost corpus manifest and carries the resulting owner map into first-plan RunOps.

package_manifests.note: Skill and Plugin manifests advance together to 1.7.42 without changing transport, trust, consent, or compatibility-family boundaries.

workspace_cli.note: Workspace/Admin CLI remain at 0.1.0-beta.32; registry-backed update checks return an exact install command plus post-install verification, and Workspace capabilities expose server-owned limits.

help_center.note: Three-language guides explain that future-continuity retention is not complete at upload when related evidence has a Work Model owner, without exposing an internal taxonomy recipe.

package_setup.note: Setup and the short SessionStart reminder preserve broad read activation without manufacturing write preference; canonical Skill projection carries the topology behavior.

harness_and_mainline.note: The owner history records both the Host stop-after-upload miss and the subsequent source-shaped first Mission plan, keeping both repairs in Agent intent/Work Model planning rather than Runtime topology enforcement.

external_marketplaces.note: First-party 1.7.42 publication and hashes can be verified here; WorkBuddy Marketplace, Claude directory acceptance, and fresh independent-host behavior remain external receipts.

release_evidence.note: Focused tests cover adapter convergence, upload-to-organization routing, explicit retain-only countercases, package export, and localized Help; a fresh Codex J1T1 rerun is the behavior gate before the remaining 29 turns.
